en-US.description: Desktop app to discover, install, and manage MCP servers for AI agents
en-US.longDescription:
MCP Desktop lets you discover and one-click install 3,400+ Model Context Protocol servers
across Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and any AI client. Browse the full Vinkius catalog,
manage server configurations, and keep everything in sync from a single native app.
en-US.name: MCP Desktop
